description: This file contains automated tests for the Azure Queue Adapter implementation within an Orleans streaming environment. It utilizes xUnit testing framework to verify queue message sending, receiving, and cache behavior.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: A test suite for Azure Queue Stream Adapter, verifying message transmission, cache integrity, and stream ordering within Orleans.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes test resources asynchronously. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up Azure queues used during testing asynchronously.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromAzureQueue
methods.description: Main test method that sets up the queue adapter, sends messages, receives messages, and verifies cache and message order correctness.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromQueueAdapter
methods.description: Performs detailed send/receive operations, caches messages, and verifies message integrity and order across multiple streams and queues.

methods.name: CreateEvents
methods.description: Generates a list of random integer or string events for testing message queues.

methods.name: MakeClusterId
methods.description: Generates a unique cluster identifier based on current UTC timestamp.
